title: Conjecture
description: One falsifiable claim formed from evidence, structured so it cannot enter review without stating what would refute it.

claim.description: Exactly one claim, stated as a single sentence — not a list of claims.

scope.description: The boundary within which the claim is asserted to hold.

assumptions.description: Background assumptions the claim depends on.

supporting_evidence.description: Source-record references or excerpts that support the claim.

contrary_evidence.description: Source-record references or excerpts that weigh against the claim.

possible_refuting_evidence.description: What observation, if made, would refute this claim. Mandatory: a claim that cannot state what would count against it is structurally incomplete.

planned_tests.description: Concrete checks planned to look for the refuting evidence described above.

qualifications.description: Caveats on the claim's strength or confidence.

content_hash.description: Hex digest (e.g. SHA-256) of the conjecture's content, for change detection.
